name: GitHub
description: Trigger Recursive automations from GitHub — issues, pull requests, pushes, releases, and comments fire event-mode automations via repository webhooks. Requires a Pro or Teams license.

events.label: Issue activity (opened, edited, closed…)
events.description: An issue was opened, edited, closed, reopened, labeled, or assigned. Filter by action (e.g. opened) to narrow.

events.label: Issue / PR comment
events.description: A comment was created, edited, or deleted on an issue or pull request.

events.label: Pull request activity (opened, synchronize, closed…)
events.description: A pull request was opened, edited, synchronized, closed, merged, or review-requested. Filter by action to narrow.

events.label: Push to a branch
events.description: Commits were pushed to a branch or tag. Filter by branch (e.g. main) to narrow.

events.label: Release activity (published, created…)
events.description: A release was published, created, edited, or deleted.

onboarding.subtitle: Connect a GitHub repository so issues, pull requests, pushes, and releases trigger agents.

steps.title: Open your repository's webhook settings
steps.desc: Repository → Settings → Webhooks → Add webhook (or org-level Settings → Webhooks to cover every repo).

steps.title: Set a Webhook Secret
steps.desc: Generate a random secret, paste it into the webhook's Secret field on GitHub, and save the same value here. Verifies inbound requests (X-Hub-Signature-256).

steps.title: Add a GitHub Token (optional)
steps.desc: Fine-grained personal access token or classic token. Optional — needed only for agents to post results back (comment on issues/PRs). Not used to verify webhooks.

steps.title: Verify setup
steps.desc: Confirm the required credentials are in place.

schema.label: Webhook Secret
schema.description: The webhook's Secret value (repository/org Settings → Webhooks). Used to verify the X-Hub-Signature-256 HMAC on every inbound request.

schema.label: GitHub Token
schema.description: Personal access token (github_pat_… / ghp_…). Optional — required only for agents to post results back to GitHub (issue/PR comments). Never used for webhook verification.
